fusions.name: Grab a Handful
fusions.desc: Grabs at everything in reach, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Choicest Cut
fusions.desc: Tears the best cut off a target for 30 damage, healing you for 30% of the damage dealt and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Cheek Pouches
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second for 6 seconds, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
